claims.claim: Oklo reported that its Groves isotope test reactor achieved first criticality on August 6, 2026 after DOE startup authorization in July.

factors.name: advanced nuclear execution signal
factors.basis: first criticality is a concrete operating milestone demonstrating reactor project execution capability

risks.risk: Groves is an isotope test reactor; its milestone does not itself establish commercial Aurora licensing or economics.

causalEdges.mechanism: operating experience can reduce execution uncertainty for future nuclear assets
causalEdges.falsifier: Aurora licensing/construction milestones fail to translate despite Groves execution

unknowns.unknown: Commercial Aurora schedule and realized unit economics remain unproven.

claims.claim: Oklo published its Q2 2026 financial results and business update on August 7 while accelerating first-of-a-kind project activity and maintaining substantial liquidity.

factors.name: pre-revenue project execution
factors.basis: technical milestones are advancing, but commercial deployment remains capital intensive and not yet proven at scale

risks.risk: First-of-a-kind nuclear deployment requires continued regulatory, fuel, construction and capital execution before durable commercial cash flow.

causalEdges.mechanism: procurement and project work can pull forward critical-path readiness
causalEdges.falsifier: higher spend does not translate into licensing/construction progress

unknowns.unknown: No canonical valuation or probability-weighted commercialization conclusion is asserted.
